name: JAVA 佳沃 Vega TT 24S
why_interesting: The exact mainland Vega TT 24S card now has current manufacturer, event and two regional reference-build anchors.

facts.frame_material: J-AIR T800 carbon frame, carbon fork and carbon seatpost on the current Chilean reference build; the Mexican build independently states a full-carbon Toray frame
facts.frame_construction: Aerodynamic UCI-claimed TT frame with fully internal cable routing, integrated seatpost adjustment, 100/142 mm thru axles and BB86
facts.drivetrain: L-TWOO ER9 electronic 2x12 / 24-speed, 50/34T crank and 11-32T cassette with L-TWOO hydraulic disc brakes
facts.complete_weight_basis: Current Chilean complete-bike reference-build claim; size, pedals, accessories and measurement method are not stated
facts.wheels: Current Chilean reference build: DECAF carbon 88 mm front wheel and carbon rear disc wheel
facts.stiffness_evidence: No exact-model numeric stiffness result or sufficiently specific independent frame-stiffness assessment was found across the 50-area sweep

missing: Maximum tire clearance, fitted tire specification and a complete current geometry table
Complete-weight size, pedal basis, accessories and measurement method
Meaningful exact-model stiffness evidence, exact selected mainland trim, domestic warranty route and final checkout price
source_note: The retained card identifies Vega TT 24S at CNY 12,999. Current EUROBIKE and regional JAVA pages establish the ER9 2x12 carbon reference build and a 9.8 kg claim; components may vary and no source publishes maximum tire clearance or complete weight basis.
